description: This is a modern accent chair with a rounded, enveloping backrest and arms. The seat cushion is plush and inviting, offering a comfortable place to relax. The chair is supported by a sleek, minimalist white base, which elevates it slightly off the ground. Its smooth, seamless design and neutral color palette make it a versatile piece that can complement various interior design styles. The upholstery appears to be a soft fabric, possibly velvet or a high-quality synthetic, contributing to its luxurious and cozy feel.
